vector_sql: SELECT id FROM documents WHERE allow_access = 'OPEN' AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY l2_distance(embedding, ?) LIMIT 2
fulltext_sql: SELECT id FROM documents WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST (? IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND allow_access = 'OPEN' AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY MATCH(body) AGAINST (? IN BOOLEAN MODE) DESC, id LIMIT 2
